post.description: Find wholesale products and suppliers in Alibaba's public keyword listing (/premium/<keyword>.html), which is mostly sponsored placements. Returns 40 offers per page with source price strings and MOQ, not normalized price or verified inventory. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor for the next page; the listing serves about 50 pages (2,000 offers), so has_more is false past page 50 even when source_total is larger. Narrow the query to reach offers beyond that.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token: pass next_cursor from a previous search response unchanged, with the same query. Omit for the first page.
